title: Must see Starbucks app hack!!! *How to get free stars*

asr.full_text: Alright, so the other day I went to Starbucks, and I got really excited after I ordered because I'm a fan of the Starbucks app. If you don't have the Starbucks app and you love Starbucks, you really need to get it. The way the Starbucks app works is, you download it on your phone, you can add cards to it, you can add gift cards that people give to you, you can add them to your account, and then when you go to pay. you can select those gift cards or transfer money from your banking account to pay for your beverages and food So I've been using the app for a while And one feature of the app is they're always sending you their promotion deals So as you order from Starbucks you get stars So usually it's for every dollar spent you get a certain amount of stars but then they do these things called star dashes where they'll send you a message so if you go on your inbox you can go to active offers so before I go to Starbucks I do this every time I look in my starbucks app in my messages and I can see if there's any active offers going on right now. All you have to do is say start now when you want to add an offer to your Starbucks account. So you go in you find the active offers and then usually. It's like you have to buy this this and this and then you can get this many points. Well right now they're doing one that if you order by December 24th four times then you will get 50 bonus starts if you order a hundred or if you order five times you get a hundred bonus stars and if you order six times you get a hundred and fifty bonus starts so I never really knew what it meant like if it was you got fifty bonus stars for ordering for different times ordering four drinks so if it was on the same receipt never really knew what their breakdown was so if it had to be different checkouts, if it had to be different drinks or different food items. So I was kind of wondering this because I wanted away, I was ordering a couple different drinks when I went to Starbucks this day and I knew that I wanted to try to get 150 bonus stars cause if I did that would be getting a free drink. Because after $125 you can trade those stars in for free beverage. So I downloaded this offer and I went to go order my husband and my drink. And then I was like you know what I really want to use up all the little bits of change from all the gift cards I've accumulated over the past year, so I must have eight different gift cards on there some have a 0 balance, some had a $1 balance, some had a $0.50 balance, and usually I just reload one of the cards, and so I really wanted to 50 cent balance and usually I just reload one of the cards and so I really wanted to use up all the little change amounts and so when I went to order there was 5 different cards that had money on it so I told the guy I want to use up all the remaining balances on my gift cards. He said, that's fine, so if you click Pay at the bottom right hand corner the green button, click Pay. And then do the drop down menu where it says the card and the amount you have on the card hit the drop down menu And then you can select the different cards that you have on file well after I checked out I had had them scan each card and I use the total of five cards after I checked out I locked back into my Starbucks app to kind of understand if I got two different times if that counted as two times towards my six cause I'm trying to get to the hundred and fifty which I get after I order six times and I guess what they consider an order is every time a card gets scanned so I received five different check offs so I got a 100 bonus stars for ordering two beverages that totaled about $10 I got a hundred bonus stars which basically is at the free drink status and if I would have had one more gift card on my account that had a couple cents on it then I would have been getting the free drink and the hundred of fifty Bonasstars so from now on all you have to do when you go to Starbucks is get different cards on your account so if you ever get a gift card don't delete it save your cards on your starbucks app and then add a couple bucks to each one and then maybe a dollar to each one even and when you go use five different cards activate the offer that you have in your Inbox and then when you have them pay or when you were paying have them scan each card so then it totals you know five dollars for the drink and you got your five checkoffs for how many you needed to get the bonus stars. So, yeah it was pretty amazing I'm gonna do it every time.

textual.context: The title calls the method an app hack, and the speaker presents it as a personal promotional/tutorial method for obtaining Starbucks bonus stars; no warning or explicit denial is provided.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed free-drink reward is directly linked to maintaining multiple gift cards, activating an offer, and requesting separate card scans so a single beverage purchase produces multiple checkoffs; later review could assess whether this described method matches the offer's stated conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether Starbucks permits or prohibits counting separate card scans this way, whether the app or staff consistently process the transactions as described, or whether the speaker actually received the claimed outcome.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a personal tutorial about using Starbucks app offers and gift-card balances to earn loyalty stars toward a free beverage. Although the title uses "hack" and the speaker suggests multiple card scans, the described activity is presented as a consumer loyalty-reward tactic without established deception or a prohibited method. The sampled frame shows only the speaker in a car, so it does not verify the app screens, checkout process, or claimed outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed context is an ordinary loyalty promotion: Starbucks orders and an activated offer are described as producing bonus stars that can be exchanged for a free beverage. The speaker also gives operational instructions involving multiple gift-card scans.
